notes: «حدثنا الحميدي، ومحمد بن عبد الله، قالا» are two co-transmitters of one level, not two groups (no «ح»)
both «أبيه» are bare relations; the second is the Companion who speaks the report «قال أتت امرأة» (rule 6)
